item.title: Tangled Web:
item.content:encoded:
Well that was a wild and well-written ride all the way through!

This last part, though, not gonna lie, the Lucy Goes Philosophical landed a bit heavy/over-written; it was really the only part of this whole saga that was a slog for me to get through.

Overall, however, this adventure was so very worth it. Thanks for all the hard work y'all.

+ spoilers?
- hi mom
  • Is the Thorn meant to be the tip of a pencil? I noticed the repeated use of "paper" as an adjective in the "other" space.
  • Did Phenix die, or just the bird he was tied to? Seems weird that a demon could die from a fall down an elevator shaft.
  • The Robot isn't necessarily dead, just… left? Or did that alternate reality completely collapse?
  • I'm confused… didn't O-10 die somewhere in there, yet is still going at the end?
  • This is the fifth bullet point. (Just in case.)

item.title: SCP-5245:
item.content:encoded:
Twilitbeing has written a very good and thorough critique on this piece. Enough so that I don't actually have much else to add.

I will add some of my own thoughts, however. There is a seed of a seed of a seed of a good idea in here, bogged down by tonal issues, very iffy dialogue, an anomaly that is way too similar to that one particular Keter mask (forgot its designation) and very lackluster execution.

I, too, encourage Krystal_Cipher to return to this one day, just think everything through more clearly, actually get the greenlights first before drafting, get a boatload of critique and make sure that critique comes from the wiki and not reddit.

I can tell what story you're trying to tell. I like the passion I'm feeling. However, this needed a lot more work before it was ready to be posted. Apologies. -1.
